mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, the temperature is 71 degrees under clear skies at the Verona Public Library, with a Waning Gibbous moon visible and an overnight low of 61 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that their Records Section manages all official documentation, including traffic crash reports which are usually available 10 days after an incident through their website portal.

There is a lot to do this weekend, starting with the Remote Area Medical Clinic taking place today at Verona Area High School, followed by live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, both happening today.
For our weekly report, on July 26, a 55-year-old woman was arrested for O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.
Today's delicious Flavor of the Day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake, and since the store is open until 10 PM tonight, you have plenty of time to stop by for a frozen treat.
